definitions.explanation: A state where things are not balanced or evenly distributed. Used in economics, politics, social contexts, and general description.

examples.japanese: {貿易|ぼうえき}の{不均衡|ふきんこう}が{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: The trade imbalance is a problem.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{経済|けいざい}{不均衡|ふきんこう}を{解消|かいしょう}する。
examples.english: To resolve the regional economic imbalance.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}の{賃金|ちんぎん}{不均衡|ふきんこう}は{多|おお}くの{国|くに}で{依然|いぜん}として{存在|そんざい}する。
examples.english: Gender wage disparity still exists in many countries.

notes:
Formed from {不|ふ} (non-) + {均衡|きんこう} (balance/equilibrium). A formal, written-style word common in news, academic writing, and policy discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{不均衡|ふきんこう} — trade imbalance
- {経済|けいざい}{不均衡|ふきんこう} — economic imbalance
- {情報|じょうほう}の{不均衡|ふきんこう} — information asymmetry
- {不均衡|ふきんこう}を{是正|ぜせい}する — to correct an imbalance
- {不均衡|ふきんこう}を{解消|かいしょう}する — to resolve an imbalance

Also used as a na-adjective: {不均衡|ふきんこう}な{状態|じょうたい} (an unbalanced state).
